verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says work can be kept up to date by tracking progress from tools including Figma, with AI assistance, so the product claims this capability directly. The claim is a single marketing line with no detail on how status is changed from inside Figma. missing for 10: documented Figma plugin or workflow for updating issue status in-app, specifics of which status/fields can be changed, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
